H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H1897: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
H7385: emptiness; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain
H3320: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H7336: probably to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) honorable
H3245: to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H4899: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H4147: properly, chastisement, i.e. (by implication) a halter; figuratively, restraint
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H5688: something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H7832: to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H3932: to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H926: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
H5258: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H2706: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H7592: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H272: something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land)
H657: cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot
H7489: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good fornothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
H7626: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
H1270: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement
H3627: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
H3335: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
H5310: to dash to pieces, or scatter
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H7919: to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent
H3256: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
H3374: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
H1523: properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear
H5401: to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons
H6435: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
H599: to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1197: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be(-come) brutish
H4592: a little or few (often adverbial or compar.)
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
